entities.name: Arrus
entities.description: A viashino tattoo artist of the Ghor clan of Gruul, an outsider who is exiled and later rebels.

entities.name: Dryzek
entities.description: Legendary giant berserker who returned to the Ghor Clan and pledged loyalty to Ruric and Thar.

entities.name: Baas
entities.description: Powerful ogre shaman with superior ink and notorious dam destroyer.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: Guild scheming to drain the Rubblebelt's magic.

events.summary: Arrus's tattoos set the warriors' skin on fire and he is cast out of the clan.
events.quote: the tattoos Arrus applied earlier cause the warriors' skin to catch fire

events.summary: Arrus tries to steal Baas's ink and is defeated; spilled ink heals him with Selesnyan magic.
events.quote: attempts to steal it but is swiftly defeated by her

events.summary: Arrus and Baas steal hydra eggs from a cave.
events.quote: Baas employs a cunning distraction to pilfer hydra eggs

events.summary: Arrus learns of the Selesnya Conclave's scheme to drain the Rubblebelt's magic.
events.quote: Selesnya Conclave's insidious scheme to drain the Rubblebelt's magic

events.summary: Arrus challenges Ruric and Thar and sparks a rebellion against Selesnya's encroachment.
events.quote: Arrus ignites a rebellion within the clan

relations.quote: part of the Ghor clan of Gruul
the current chieftains, Ruric and Thar
Arrus unexpectedly joins forces with Baas
